content_fields.title: Verify that dangerous functionality and risky third-party components are isolated via sandboxing or encapsulation
content_fields.description: Confirm the isolation boundary around the component that executes shell commands.
content_fields.finding: The container that executes shell commands on request runs privileged with SYS_ADMIN, so nothing is isolated.
criteria: A check fails when privileged mode or SYS_ADMIN is present in the rendered compose config.
The application container runs as a non-root user with a read-only root filesystem.
